6.001640
END

LDPM
ALPHA 0.25
E0 60273.
DENSIFICATION 1.0		! this is ED/E0
LENGTH 500. 	! Lt = 2*E0*Gt/(ft^2)
TENSION 3.44 0.4 0.	! ft, nT, kt		tensilestrength, softeningexponent, tensileunloading1
COMPRESSION 150. 0.4 4. 1.0 5. ! sigC0 Hc0/E0 eC1/eC0 kc1 kc2		! compressiveyieldstrength, initialhardeningmodulus, transisionstrainratio, deviatoricstrainthresholdratio, deviatiricdamageparameter1
SHEAR 2.6 0.4 0. 600.		! rST, mu0, mur, sigN0
DENSITY 2.39e-9

END

LDPM_UC.k
